evidence: only-tls-1-3-is-accepted: nginx_frontend_domain.pp:695 passes $base_ssl_protocols to the domain's HTTPS server; with the base fixture it comes from the default prefix ['TLSv1.3'] (:92) and no additional protocols, so a TLS 1.3 handshake on www succeeding and a TLS 1.2 one refused is exactly what the lines produce

dynamic-dns-proxies-through-the-variable: nginx_frontend_domain.pp:560-561 sets proxy to '$proxy_backend' when dynamic_dns_resolution is on and no pass suffix is set (the dyn fixture sets none); with :397's set $proxy_backend http://127.0.0.1:8080 and the resolver (:710, default 127.0.0.53) the probe checks the set line, proxy_pass $proxy_backend, a valid config and the backend page over HTTPS, all of which the lines declare

the-monitoring-server-answers: nginx_frontend.pp:222 names the monitoring server <trusted hostname>.monitoring.<domain>; the probe builds that name from hostname -s and the fixture domain, and checks the /etc/hosts pin (:265), the 200 'Hello World!\n' text/plain return (:220, :241-249) and the stub status (:254-260) to 127.0.0.1, which the code produces with server_monitoring_create true

purpose covered: Purpose (frontend for a domain: HTTP->HTTPS redirects, TLS proxy to the backend with the class-managed certificate, a 404 default server, a monitoring server with stub status and its Nagios check) matches the header comments and manifest. Base run tests the redirects (301 keeping path and query on naked and www), the TLS proxy to a live backend with certificate verification per name (and failure for a name the cert lacks), TLS 1.3-only, the 404 default server over HTTP and HTTPS (mismatch with the domain name fails), the monitoring server, the 403 off loopback (mismatch from 127.0.0.1 fails) and the Nagios check's 0/1/2 exits. The prod variant now tests redirect_default and decorate_naked as real 301s to https://www.<domain> over HTTP and HTTPS (both distinguishable from the defaults: 404 and 301 to the naked name; the mismatch on www over HTTPS fails), and the render check's remaining lines each depend on its parameter (.pem bundle, 121s/31s/122s timeouts, ad-hoc and other-location add_header lines, X-P8test-Set header, TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3, /p8test-suffix, www_fix_redirect proxy_redirect); the two vacuous lines of the failed review are gone. dyn tests dynamic_dns_resolution end to end; rhel tests the RedHat key directory. The accepted gap lists exactly parameters with no row in fleet_variant_usage.md for nginx_frontend (checked: production sets only the 17 listed there, all covered); none hides a lab-testable production behaviour. Left out: server_monitoring_create's default false (absent monitoring server) is untested, a minor residue of a parameter production leaves at its default. All runs (base, prod, dyn, rhel) ALL_PASS, no findings.
